Refuse all other destinations and run the range on a host-only network with no route to the office, internet, cameras, microphones, or actuators. Put the exploit logic behind a feature flag that expires with the range and require two-person approval for each run. The cleanup phase should revoke the test token, restore the emulator snapshot, delete captured canaries, rotate lab credentials, and confirm that no process or route remains outside the host-only segment. A useful student report should explain the vulnerable trust boundary, show the evidence that the test succeeded, identify the compensating controls, and demonstrate that patching the image causes the same request to fail safely.
